The legend on the right shows that B represents births, D represents deaths, and arrows represent migrant population. There are also numbered arrows between the cities in the diagram, but these arrows represent population migration. Then reason: the question asks about the natural population growth rate; natural population growth only considers births and deaths, that is, compares B-D, and does not consider migration arrows. Also because the question stem states that the populations of the four cities at the beginning of a certain year are equal, the denominators of the natural growth rates are the same, so it is only necessary to rank according to the size of B-D for each city. According to the comparison of the B and D values in the diagram, city 1 has the smallest B-D, city 3 is next, city 2 is after that, and city 4 is the largest. Therefore the city-number sequence from low to high is 1324.

What is the order of the natural population growth rates of these four cities from low to high? Please write the sequence by city number.

method.method_draft: 先描述并读取图像：四个城市圆圈中分别列出B（出生人口）和D（死亡人口），箭头表示迁移人口。再结合题干“某年年初人口相等”和问题要求“人口自然增长率由低到高”，忽略迁移箭头，只计算每个城市的B-D。由于分母相同，按B-D从小到大排序：1号最低，3号次之，2号再次，4号最高，因此写出顺序1324。

再推理：题目问人口自然增长率，人口自然增长只看出生人口和死亡人口，即比较B-D，不考虑迁移箭头。又因为题干说明四个城市某年年初人口相等，所以自然增长率的分母相同，只需按各城市B-D的大小排序。根据图中B、D数值比较，1号城市B-D最小，3号次之，2号再次，4号最大。因此由低到高的城市编号顺序为1324。

planner_metadata.image_role: 图中四个圆分别代表编号1、2、3、4城市，每个圆内有B、D两项人口数，旁边还有表示迁移人口的箭头。需要读取各城市的B和D数值或至少比较B-D：1号自然增长为负且最低，3号接近零或较小，2号为正且高于3号，4号为正且最大。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 人口自然增长率=（出生人口-死亡人口）/年初总人口；自然增长只看出生和死亡，不看迁入迁出。因题干说明四城市年初人口相等，所以比较自然增长率等价于比较各城市的“出生人口-死亡人口”大小。
